## About
Palacio Tire and Muffler Shop is the tire and exhaust shop on S Seguin Ave in New Braunfels. We carry economical and premium tires, including all-season and performance tires, and we take care of balancing, tire repair, rotation and TPMS work.
Exhaust is the other half of our name. We handle exhaust system repair, replace catalytic converters and downpipes, and install new mufflers set up the way you want them. Folks come to us from New Braunfels, San Marcos, Seguin and the surrounding areas.
We're open every day, Sunday included, and we're grateful for a 4.6 rating from 185 Google reviews.

## Services
- Tire purchase and installation: Economical and premium tires, including all-season and performance tires, from leading brands.
- Balancing, rotation and tire repair: Computerized wheel balancing, tire rotation and tire repair to keep your tires wearing evenly and holding air.
- Tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS): Service for your tire pressure monitoring system, so you know when a tire is running low.
- Exhaust system repair: Exhaust inspection, catalytic converter replacement, center exhaust section replacement and downpipe replacement.
- New muffler: New mufflers with duals and matching tips, routed the way you want. One reviewer had a Flowmaster muffler with duals put on here.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: Yes. On Sunday we're open from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

Q: Can I get in the same day?
A: Give us a call. One reviewer with a cracked exhaust was able to get an appointment that same day.

Q: Can you give me an estimate before you start?
A: Yes. Our mechanics will look at the issue and give you a reliable estimate.
